name: 04901 · Waterville, ME
findings: ZIP 04901 (Waterville) has 98 nonprofit organizations. 24 of them (24%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 04901 (Waterville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
25% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 04901 (Waterville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 49% of the typical level).
